EDITORIAL.description: Historical R10 author acceptance is retained. Current R11 source9fe9b70 and regenerated reader/PDF/platform kit require exact author editorial/visual acceptance before Ready/stable staging. Draft preview preparation is authorized; it is not acceptance. Platform-native transfer/posting remains author-manual after verified website publication; no repeated prior R10 permission is required.

EVIDENCE.description: Primary sources support their bounded claims; author synthesis and illustrative risks remain distinguished; source access limitations retained.

INDEPENDENT.description: Four distinct completed source-bound clean-context Requirements/Code/White-box/Exploratory results plus corrections.

VISUAL.description: Inspect actual desktop/mobile/no-JS reader and five PDF pages; images/captions/references/related links remain readable.

DELIVERY.description: Exact-source native publisher/Basic and hosted checks; authenticated staging, identical-tree protected merge, production rights/archive and actual served article/PDF verification. Exact maintained AC/check allocation: review/issue-169/native-check-allocation.md; native Basic/content-source/hosted results are separate required observations, not implied by RI.

COPY.description: Prepare complete matching LinkedIn/Medium copies now with a visible planned stable website backlink and resolved launch URLs. Planned links never establish publication/canonical/date. Verify the actual served website edition before author-manual platform posting; then verify both actual platform URLs and website backlinks and add the reciprocal pair together via one materials-only content update. Exact current platform editors/live URLs and posting remain manual external gates; the later pair does not block initial website release.

HISTORY.description: Retain initial Draft PR milestone and source/plan history; current author publication instruction supersedes historical no-publish boundaries without erasing history.

TECHNICAL.description: TR01–TR08: bounded test/repository tool class, monotonic registry, source/Python/security/advisories/RI/owning evidence, four-role review, old-main full bootstrap and exact-head App trust; actual subsequent technical native run proves no website deployment.
